newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Azizia-Panda net profits increase.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Azizia-Panda net profits increase.

text.p: The Saudi al-Azizia Panda United Inc said it posted a net profit of 44.2 million riyal ($11.7 million) net profit in the first nine months of 1996.

A company statement released late on Friday said overall sales jumped 31 percent to 450 million riyals in the first nine months from 344 million riyals in the same period in 1995, thanks to aggressive marketing and improved customer services.
Saudi Prince Al-Waleed bin Talal, who has many international holdings including a stake in Euro Disney, acquired a 50 percent stake in the chain in 1993 and merged it with another company.
